title: Asahina Mafuyu — Desolate Kitchen〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (There's still rice in the freezer, so I can thaw some of that...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I also need a couple of eggs... And green onions.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I just need to get her to eat something right now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you all worry about me like this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't need to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I mean, you're composing this song just for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'd like to work alone for a while so I can focus more on what I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I know this is asking a lot of you, but would it be possible for you to work in the bedroom?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, and please feel free to eat and take baths whenever you like. You don't have to mind me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You need to eat something, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have something once I've reached a good stopping point.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Here's that pot...
I need to fill it with water and some Japanese broth...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should probably add extra water...
A gentler flavor should make it easier for her to stomach.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I watched as Kanade's face gradually lost its color.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I knew she was neither getting enough sleep, nor eating properly.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I knew because I was there next to her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I knew that I had to stop her.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But Kanade's been working so hard for me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't want her pushing herself so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's trying to ask me something...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should stop the stove for now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line: I heard Ena shouting just now.
